summary: Hotel101 Global Holdings Corp. filed a Form 6-K with a press release on April 28, 2026, announcing strong early booking performance for its newly opened 680-room Hotel101-Madrid property. The release highlights over 45,000 room night bookings generating ~$5.4 million revenue since March 10, 2026, and outlines 2026 expansion plans including additional hotels in the Philippines and Japan. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation event is disclosed. This is a routine operational update on business performance and growth pipeline of a foreign private issuer, not triggering any special-situation category.
